instruction: Match each HeadOffice from the second table to the Branch in the first table and fill in the Officer Name accordingly, ensuring the correct officer is assigned to Vastral.

metadata.explanation: Task requires filling Officer Name column for all areas in second table using VLOOKUP logic. All areas have HeadOffice=Ahmedabad which maps to officer 'C. D. Dey' in the first table. Evaluator checks all 11 areas with partial credit scoring.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Partial credit: score = (number of correctly filled areas) / (total areas). All 11 areas should have officer 'C. D. Dey' based on their HeadOffice being Ahmedabad.
